title: NextPay named among top innovators in the world
summary: Homegrown financial technology (fintech) player NextPay, a startup backed by the Sy, Gokongwei, and Ayala Groups, has clinched a podium finish in the recent Shell LiveWIRE Top Ten Innovators Awards for the Business Innovation Category.
